description: There is an equivalence between rational Dedekind cuts and the real numbers which preserves and reflects order by inclusion and sends each rational cut to the same rational real number.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.cut_real_order_equiv :
  ∃ e,
    (∀ (A B : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.Cut), ↑A ⊆ ↑B ↔ e A ≤ e B) ∧
      ∀ (q : ℚ), e (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalCut q) = ↑q
